note: #532 refuses client writes to tenants.addons. The digest below is appended. Earlier rules digests are not replaced. No other match block moved.

entries.why: #532 appends addons to the tenants/{tenantId} update deny list, beside plan, status, and ownerId. The Dodo webhook writes that map through the Admin SDK, which bypasses rules. A branding or settings admin can no longer updateDoc socialScheduler or any other add-on count. The super-admin branch is unchanged. No other match block moved.
